note: sidebar and toolbox action groups -- renders the closed vocabulary of fixed navigation and interface-action controls
sidebar toolbox heading -- renders the platform-defined sidebar section label
sidebar section headings -- renders the closed vocabulary of platform-defined navigation group labels
menus for sidebar items -- renders the fixed vocabulary of item-management controls while leaving user-created channel and member names masked
application footer brand link -- renders the operator's fixed Rocket.Chat branding
room-header controls -- renders the fixed vocabulary of channel-header action buttons, excluding the user-selected channel name
room action toolbar -- renders the closed vocabulary of fixed channel actions
message formatting toolbar -- renders the closed vocabulary of fixed composer-formatting controls
emoji-picker control -- renders the fixed composer control for selecting emoji
audio-message control -- renders the fixed composer control for recording or sending an audio message
message action menu -- renders the fixed composer control for additional message actions
